name: Lavender
benefits: calming, sleep promotion, anxiety relief, headache relief, skin soothing, anti-inflammatory
uses: diffuse at bedtime for sleep, apply diluted to temples for headaches, add to bath for relaxation, blend with carrier oil for massage
emotional_benefits: reduces stress, eases anxiety, promotes emotional balance, lifts mild depression, creates sense of calm and security
blending_notes: blends well with cedarwood, bergamot, chamomile, geranium, clary sage, ylang ylang, frankincense

name: Jojoba
benefits: deeply moisturizing, balances skin sebum, anti-inflammatory, long shelf life, suitable for all skin types, hair nourishing
uses: use as standalone moisturizer, blend with essential oils for massage, apply to hair as treatment, use in DIY skincare
emotional_benefits: promotes feelings of self-care and nourishment
blending_notes: excellent base for all essential oil blends, absorbs quickly without greasiness, will not go rancid
contraindications: rarely causes reactions, suitable for sensitive skin
safety_notes: technically a liquid wax not an oil — extremely stable, no dilution needed as carrier
keywords: moisturizer, skin, hair, carrier, base, sensitive skin, anti-aging, all skin types

name: Coconut
benefits: moisturizing, antimicrobial, hair strengthening, skin softening, UV protection (low SPF)
uses: blend with essential oils for body massage, use as hair mask, use as makeup remover, add to DIY lip balm
emotional_benefits: promotes warmth and comfort, associated with tropical relaxation
blending_notes: solid at room temperature — melt before blending; pairs well with tropical-scented oils
contraindications: may clog pores for acne-prone skin — use fractionated coconut oil instead
safety_notes: fractionated coconut oil stays liquid and is better for sensitive/acne-prone skin
keywords: hair, skin, moisturizing, tropical, massage, antimicrobial, natural

name: Sweet Almond
benefits: nourishing, softening, anti-inflammatory, rich in vitamin E, suitable for dry and sensitive skin
uses: use as massage oil base, blend with essential oils for skin care, use in bath oils, apply to dry skin
emotional_benefits: promotes gentle self-care, comforting for skin conditions causing stress
blending_notes: light texture pairs well with most essential oils, slightly longer absorption than jojoba
contraindications: avoid if allergic to tree nuts
safety_notes: gentle enough for baby massage when diluted appropriately
